title: Phase 4.4: In-Flight Advisory Assessment
scope: Define the AdvisoryResult contract (schema + normative doc) for the advise operation, taking exactly session-path, ledger-path, and gate-outcomes-array-path as inputs.
Define the AdvisoryDivergenceReport contract (schema + normative doc) as an independent sidecar, schema version 1.0.
Record the approved human gate decisions in ADR-0008.
nonGoals: Implementation code for the advise CLI operation.
Fixtures or tests for AdvisoryResult or AdvisoryDivergenceReport.
Any change to Evaluator.Evaluate, SessionEvaluator, StopAssessor, GateOutcomeProjector, or SessionTraceBuilder.
Persistence of AdvisoryResult or AdvisoryDivergenceReport beyond a single invocation.
Shadow mode (continuous background advisory evaluation). Deferred to Hermes / Phase 4.6.

obligations.description: Author ADR-0008 recording the approved in-flight advisory assessment decision, including the thirteen approved human-gate points, PT700+ diagnostic allocation, and allowed/protected paths.

Author contracts/advisory-result.schema.json: schemaVersion 1.0, required sessionId/taskContractId/ledgerTraceId/generatedAt/sourceDigest/classification/recommendation/obligations. classification reuses Evaluator.Evaluate's existing closed vocabulary (progress, recovery-after-failed-attempt, repeated-attempt-without-obligation-advancement, insufficient-evidence). recommendation is a required closed-vocabulary field (continue, stop-recommended, insufficient-evidence). generatedAt is a fixed const sentinel (1970-01-01T00:00:00.0000000Z), not wall-clock. obligations is non-empty (minItems 1); each entry requires obligationId, status, classification, stable, evidenceEventIds, with no field derived from free text.

Author docs/contracts/advisory-result.md covering scope, required fields, recommendation derivation rule, per-obligation structured reason (obligationId/status/classification/stable/evidenceEventIds), evaluator reuse, insufficient-evidence priority, stable-attainment reuse, SessionTraceBuilder boundary, determinism (fixed generatedAt sentinel), fail-closed behavior, CLI, non-goals, security, ownership, and compatibility.

Author contracts/advisory-divergence-report.schema.json: schemaVersion 1.0, normative required divergences array (per obligation ledgerStatus/advisoryStatus/diverged), optional non-normative rollup object. reportId is constrained to a deterministic digest shape (^[0-9a-f]{64}$), not a free-form/random string. generatedAt is a fixed const sentinel (1970-01-01T00:00:00.0000000Z), not wall-clock.

Author docs/contracts/advisory-divergence-report.md covering scope, required fields, normative per-obligation divergence, session-only diagnostic rollup, determinism (fixed generatedAt sentinel and digest-derived reportId, never a random UUID), fail-closed behavior, CLI, non-goals, security, ownership, and compatibility.

constraints: advise takes exactly three inputs: session-path, ledger-path, gate-outcomes-array-path.
Evaluator.Evaluate remains the single, unmodified classification authority.
insufficient-evidence has priority over all other classifications.
The stable-attainment helper is shared with StopAssessor; no rank or overhead field is added to it.
AdvisoryDivergenceReport is an independent sidecar, not an EscalationQueue.
Divergence is normative per obligation; the rollup is session-only diagnostic.
PT700+ is explicitly allocated to this phase's diagnostics.
Persistence and shadow mode are non-goals, deferred to Hermes / Phase 4.6.

AdvisoryResult.recommendation is a required closed-vocabulary field (continue, stop-recommended, insufficient-evidence) derived deterministically: classification insufficient-evidence => insufficient-evidence; else all targeted obligations stable=true => stop-recommended; else continue.
Each AdvisoryResult.obligations[] entry carries a structured reason (obligationId, status, classification, stable, evidenceEventIds); no field is generated from obligation description free text.
generatedAt on both AdvisoryResult and AdvisoryDivergenceReport is the fixed sentinel 1970-01-01T00:00:00.0000000Z, not a wall-clock timestamp, so identical inputs produce byte-identical output.
AdvisoryDivergenceReport.reportId is derived deterministically as the SHA-256 digest of the source AdvisoryResult's and paired ObligationLedger's canonical bytes, never a randomly generated UUID.
humanGates: advise inputs fixed to session-path, ledger-path, gate-outcomes-array-path.
stable-attainment helper shared with StopAssessor, no rank/overhead.
AdvisoryDivergenceReport is an independent sidecar, not an EscalationQueue.
divergence normative per obligation, rollup session-only diagnostic.
persistence/shadow mode is a non-goal, deferred to Hermes/4.6.
recommendation is a required closed-vocabulary field derived deterministically from classification and per-obligation stable.
each obligations[] entry carries a structured reason (obligationId, status, classification, stable, evidenceEventIds), no free text generated from description.
generatedAt on both artifacts is the fixed sentinel 1970-01-01T00:00:00.0000000Z, not a wall-clock timestamp.
AdvisoryDivergenceReport.reportId is deterministically derived from source digest/inputs, never a random UUID.
compatibility: AdvisoryResult and AdvisoryDivergenceReport both start at schemaVersion 1.0; changes to required or normative fields require a superseding ADR and a new human gate.
